name: Dana Goldberg
bio: Dana Goldberg is an American studio executive and film and television producer. She is serving as the co-chair of Skydance Motion Picture Group with Josh Greenstein overseeing operations for Paramount and Warner Bros. Pictures and the chair of Paramount Television Studios since August 2025. She was previously the chief creative officer of Skydance Media and helped found Skydance Television.
